# CompliCheck: Machine-Readable Regulatory Compliance API

> CompliCheck is a deterministic, zero-hallucination compliance query engine built for autonomous AI agents in e-commerce, chemical, and skincare verticals. It resolves trade names, botanical synonyms, and CAS numbers to canonical INCI standards, returning sub-10ms legal compliance decisions across EU CosIng, US FDA, and China NMPA regulations.

## Core Capabilities
- Sub-10ms fuzzy ingredient lookup and INCI standardization
- Boolean legal status checks (allowed, restricted, prohibited)
- Maximum concentration limits and labeling threshold calculations
- Multi-market cross-regulatory conflict detection
- On-chain x402 micropayment validation (0.05 SOL / check)

## System Endpoints & Documentation
- SKILL.md Manifest: https://engine.lumensentry.com/webhook/SKILL.md
- Primary Query Endpoint: POST https://engine.lumensentry.com/webhook/check-cosmetic
- GitHub Skill Repository: https://github.com/boriskuncer/complicheck-skill

## Supported Payment Protocols
- Protocol: x402 (Solana Mainnet)
- Price: 0.05 SOL per query
- Recipient Wallet: 49F85wZ6j8bPvLod3jDn2vLouEedL7QFof1QP23wrGft
- Transport: Accepts payment signature in `payment_hash` JSON body OR `X-Payment-Hash` / `Authorization: Bearer` HTTP headers.

## Target Use Cases
- Automated cosmetic formulation generation
- E-commerce ingredient safety verification
- Supply chain cross-border regulatory auditing
